jobs.occupation: Surventis - Münster - Global Controlling Specialist RFN with focus Business Analytics (m/f/d) (Controller/in)
jobs.description: WELCOMEIf you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in.Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us.At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place.WHAT YOU CAN EXPECTThe Global Controlling Specialist reports to the Global Head of RFN Controlling and is the key contact for Digitalization and Data Analytics topics in Controlling. Broad operational controlling and BI expertise combined with strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills are prerequisites to act as a business partner for the Refinish Leadership Team and lead cross-functional data analytics projects across regions.- You contribute to the further development of global controlling reporting solutions, ensure high data quality, and support users in making the best use of reporting tools and analytics.- Working closely with colleagues from Finance, IT, and Data & Analytics, you coordinate reporting requirements, foster effective cross-functional collaboration, and serve as a strong sparring partner on all Controlling and Digital matters.- Together with international teams, you support the digital evolution of Controlling, share knowledge, and contribute to the development of digital skills across the organization.- You help introduce automation and AI-supported solutions that improve reporting, analytics, and controlling processes while creating a positive user experience.- You also contribute to financial analyses, performance monitoring activities, and ad hoc business requests, enabling informed and transparent decision-making.- master's degree in finance, accounting, controlling, business analytics, information systems, or a related field with relevant professional experience in controlling, finance, business analytics, or a comparable area- strong knowledge of Power BI, Excel including Power Query and Power Pivot, and a solid understanding of reporting and controlling processes- self-organized and collaborative working style combined with strong communication skills, curiosity, and a continuous learning mindset- fluent German and English language skills; experience with Databricks, data warehouse environments, and modern analytics platforms is beneficial- ideally experience with automation tools such as Power Automate as well as project coordination or project management experienceWHAT WE OFFER- We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage.- We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development.- The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback.- At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio "Freizeit" with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant "Auszeit" including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center "LackiKids" and a vacation program "LackiKids on Tour".- We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week.HOW TO REACH US- Melissa Amina Rahmani (Talent Acquisition), melissa.rahmani@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005 58073, will be happy to answer any questions you may have about this position. You are also welcome to book an online meeting.
